driver: STM32N6 low-power timer LPTIM1 low-level (LL) driver as delivered by ST (STM32CubeN6 v1.4.0)

source_documents: RM0486 Rev 4 chapter 58 (LPTIM) + memory map p.181
target.hsi_contract: RM0486 Rev 4 ch.58 LPTIM register interface + memory map p.181 (LPTIM1 secure base 0x50002400)
target.safety_allocation: NOT_PROVIDED: no owner safety scope recorded for the LPTIM campaign work orders

scope: LL (header-only, __STATIC_INLINE functions) as delivered by ST: register access through the CMSIS device structure LPTIM1 (stm32n6xx.h); the RM0486 LPTIMx_ registers of instance LPTIM1 (named LPTIM_CR, LPTIM_ISR, ...)
Enable, disable and query the timer (LPTIM_CR.ENABLE); start the counter in Continuous or Single mode (LPTIM_CR.CNTSTRT / LPTIM_CR.SNGSTRT); reset the counter (LPTIM_CR.COUNTRST)
Set and read the register update mode (LPTIM_CFGR.PRELOAD) and the clock prescaler (LPTIM_CFGR.PRESC); write and read the auto-reload value (LPTIM_ARR); read the counter (LPTIM_CNT)

Query and clear the auto-reload match flag (LPTIM_ISR.ARRM, LPTIM_ICR.ARRMCF); enable, disable and query the auto-reload match interrupt (LPTIM_DIER.ARRMIE); query and clear the auto-reload update OK flag (LPTIM_ISR.ARROK, LPTIM_ICR.ARROKCF) and the interrupt enable register update OK flag (LPTIM_ISR.DIEROK, LPTIM_ICR.DIEROKCF)

Out of scope: HAL API, capture/compare channels and PWM/waveform output, encoder mode, the external clock and input selection, external trigger and timeout, the repetition counter, the update event flag and its interrupt/DMA, the asynchronous reset after read, DMA, the other LPTIM instances, the LPTIM kernel clock selection (RCC), the LL init/deinit functions of stm32n6xx_ll_lptim.c

budgets.status: development targets set by the work-order owner (2026-10-15), reused for the feature 015 benchmark set (2026-10-25) and the feature 014 operation-24 campaign (2026-10-27)

guideline: inputs/hal_driver_guideline.md (ST Cube2 HAL SAD v1.2; automated subset = checklist SWE3-07)
layer_note: Feature 014 operation-24 campaign (owner 2026-10-27: new ST LL drivers RNG, LPTIM, WWDG): ST's existing STM32CubeN6 LPTIM LL code (stm32n6xx-hal-driver v1.4.0), FROZEN. Requirements are derived from RM0486 independently of the code; secure build (CMSIS selects LPTIM1_S at 0x50002400).

scope.note: enable, start (continuous/single), counter reset, update mode, prescaler, auto-reload, counter read, auto-reload match flag and interrupt, ARROK and DIEROK update flags
